_comment: Exterior modular structure template (PROCGEN_EXTERIOR.md §9). Backs the 'C++: Conjure Keep' spell and the generate_structure adapter action. piece = vanilla EditorID (LookupByEditorID) or '0x..~Skyrim.esm'. at = LOCAL coords relative to the structure origin (forward units in front of the caster). rot_z in DEGREES. repeat = {axis, step, count} expands one entry into N stepped pieces (auto wall runs). anchor_ground=true snaps that piece's Z to land height (towers/gate); other pieces use the flatten_to_max base plane. KIT: the vanilla Whiterun city-wall STAT family (real EditorID prefix 'WR...', confirmed by the 'Whiterun Has Walls' mods that edit these exact base records). It is a CURVED, terrain-hugging kit, so exact edge-to-edge snap on a flat grid is NOT guaranteed and WILL need in-game tuning — but every piece named below is a REAL vanilla form (unknown ids log a warning and skip; no crash). The previous 'WRC*' prefix placeholders did NOT exist and are replaced.

pieces._comment: North wall run: 8 straight wall segments stepping +128 along X (the kit's straight-wall pitch is ~128 units — the '128' suffix on WRWallStrUp128 names the segment length). 'WRWallStrUp128' is a real WR straight-wall STAT (Whiterun Mesh Fixes patch notes reference 'WRWallStrUp128'). _todo: confirm exact variant + pitch in-game.

Four corner towers. 'WRWallTower01' is a REAL vanilla WR tower STAT (referenced in 'Whiterun Has Walls Redone' / 'Whiterun Mesh Fixes' patch notes editing this base record). Ground-anchored so each tower foot sits on the land.

Gatehouse on the front (south) edge centre, ground-anchored. 'WRWallMainGate' is the REAL vanilla Whiterun main-gate STAT (referenced in 'Whiterun Has Walls' / parallax-fix patch notes editing this base record).
Central tower as the 'keep' (no clean vanilla freestanding keep STAT could be verified, so a real tower stands in rather than an invented 'WRCKeep01'). Reuses the verified WRWallTower01.

_confidence: MEDIUM — the WR EditorID FAMILY is confirmed real (WRWallTower01, WRWallMainGate, WRWallStrUp128 are vanilla base records edited by the popular 'Whiterun Has Walls' / 'Whiterun Mesh Fixes' mods). NOT verified: the exact straight-wall variant/pitch, the precise piece footprint, and whether these curved city-wall pieces tile cleanly on the flat grid used here. No FormIDs are invented; if a name mistypes it is skipped with a warning.
_known_limits: No distant LOD (structure vanishes outside the active 5x5 grid; footprint kept <= 3x3 cells). No runtime navmesh (NPCs can't path; player can walk it). Terrain is only VISUALLY levelled via flatten_to_max + ground-anchored towers/gate — the heightmap is not modified (PROCGEN_EXTERIOR.md §3). The Whiterun wall kit is curved/terrain-hugging, so straight-grid placement WILL show gaps/overlaps until tuned in-game.
_todo: IN-GAME VALIDATION needed: (1) console 'help WRWall' to confirm exact EditorIDs (WRWallStrUp128 variant, WRWallTower01, WRWallMainGate) and grab their FormIDs; (2) measure each piece's NIF pivot/length and adjust 'at'/'step' (currently assuming a 128-unit straight-wall pitch) so segments snap edge-to-edge (PROCGEN_EXTERIOR.md §2 snap math); (3) consider swapping to a cleaner straight modular kit (e.g. an Imperial Fort exterior 'ImpExt...' family) if the curved Whiterun walls do not tile acceptably.
